# DateRangePickerMode

`Flare.Components.DateRangePickerMode`

How a FlareDateRangePicker presents the range selection.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Fields` | `0` | Two linked date inputs (start and end), each with its own calendar popup. The default. |
| `Calendar` | `1` | A single inline calendar where you click the start day then the end day; the days in between are highlighted and a live preview follows the pointer while choosing the end. |

## Used by components

- `FlareDateRangePicker`
